title: ACTS TEN THIRTY EIGHT
THE HEALING BALM
end: The Healing Balm — receive God's healing peace
stock_queries: tranquil turquoise living waters flowing gently
warm golden sanctuary light filtering through leaves
white dove soaring over serene calm waters
gentle morning light on still mountain lake
soft golden rays resting on tranquil forest stream
peaceful turquoise river flowing through quiet valley

scenes.a: If you are sitting alone in the quiet waiting for relief, listen to this promise.
Father, we come before you acknowledging our weariness and physical pain today.
Your word reminds us of how God anointed Jesus of Nazareth with the Holy Ghost and with power:
who went about doing good, and healing all that were oppressed of the devil; for God was with him.
Lord, touch every aching muscle, every struggling breath, and every weary mind in this very moment.
Grant your quiet comfort and deep restorative peace to everyone receiving this prayer today.
